fightSong.title: When Pigs Fly
fightSong.lyrics: They said it couldn't happen, they said no way / Watch the pigs fly on game day / Over the river, through the sky / Flying Pigs, we own the sky!

stadium.name: The Sty
stadium.tradition: The Flight — a drone swarm forms a flying pig pre-game. If it completes the loop without crashing, good luck. 2024: crashed into press box.

fanCulture.description: They wear pig snouts. After touchdowns they oink in unison. They eat chili on spaghetti and defend it violently. Underdogs by design.
fanCulture.tailgate: Skyline chili, goetta, and debates about pork.

rivalries.name: The Ohio Jam
rivalries.narrative: North vs south Ohio. They rock, we fly.

paAnnouncer.touchdownCall: FLYING PIG TOUCHDOWN! When pigs fly!

cityFlavor: Three-way chili, flying pig marathon, and a chip on our shoulder the size of the Ohio River.
